name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Exotic.rank_equiv_combination
title: Hidden matrix equivalence preserves the rank of every linear combination
statement: Let K be a field, A (m x m) and B (n x n) invertible, M_1..M_k in K^(m x n) and a in K^k. Then rank(sum_j a_j (A M_j B)) = rank(sum_j a_j M_j). So a MinRank / rank-gap test on a matrix space published under a hidden equivalence (matrix code equivalence, slices of tensor isomorphism, Gram matrices under lattice isomorphism) is the same test on the statement's own space.
